note: S79 uses the Python sibling recount that C14 validated against the pathmap walk at 0.00%, so no new unvalidated instrument sits under the number. Counts and digests only, no timings.

controls.name: C_probes_are_absent_and_proofs_verify
controls.must_fire_because: an "absence proof" for a key that is present, or one the verifier rejects, is a number about nothing -- W1 shipped four controls with no verification function at all
controls.can_fail_because: any probe is found present by prove_membership, or any absence proof fails verification
controls.null_must_contain: W2's prove_membership, which is free to find any probe present, and verify_non_membership, which is free to return False

controls.name: C_probes_are_deep_misses
controls.must_fire_because: A27: probes that diverge at the root measure the CHEAP miss and S73 published a flat 293 B that way; W2's ~2.0 KB is about the realistic deep miss
controls.can_fail_because: mean divergence depth is below 2 for any set, i.e. the probes leave the trie immediately
controls.null_must_contain: a divergence depth free to come out at 0 or 1, which is exactly what a random-byte probe would give on these key sets

controls.name: C_absence_tracks_branching_like_membership
controls.must_fire_because: S77 generalised to 'proof size is set by branching, not key length' from membership alone; if absence orders the sets differently, that sentence is membership-only and S77 overreached
controls.can_fail_because: the absence ordering differs from the membership ordering on these three sets
controls.null_must_contain: three key sets whose absence proofs are built independently of the membership measurement and are free to rank in any of six orders

controls.name: C_real_prover_agrees_on_absence_ordering
controls.must_fire_because: the model charges ALL children at the divergence point, which is a claim about what a proof must carry; a prover that exists is the check on it
controls.can_fail_because: W2's real absence bytes rank the sets differently from the modelled digest counts
controls.null_must_contain: W2's prove_non_membership, written before this spike and free to rank the sets any way

controls.name: C_absence_costs_more_than_membership
controls.must_fire_because: the model says absence carries every child at the divergence point where membership carries all but one, so absence must be strictly dearer -- if it is not, the model is wrong about what an absence proof has to show
controls.can_fail_because: any set shows absence costing no more than membership
controls.null_must_contain: membership digest counts measured in S77, which this spike does not recompute and cannot adjust

falsifier: if non-membership proof cost does not track branching the way membership does -- i.e. if the absence ordering differs from the membership ordering -- then S77's "proof size is set by branching, not key length" is membership-only and overreached
